verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Nay, but I do swear by this city —
And thou art dwelling in this city —
And I swear by the begetter and whom he begot,
We have surely created man to face hardships.

verses.ar: اَیَحۡسَبُ اَنۡ لَّنۡ یَّقۡدِرَ عَلَیۡہِ اَحَدٌ ۘ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: Does he think that no one has power over him?
He says, ‘I have spent enormous wealth.’
Does he think that no one sees him?
Have We not given him two eyes,
And a tongue and two lips?
[✲]And We have pointed out to him the two highways of good and evil.
w: and We have pointed out to him
the two highways of good and evil

verses.en: [✲]But he attempted not the ascent courageously.
[✲]And what should make thee know what the ascent is?
It is the freeing of a slave.

verses.ar: اَوۡ اِطۡعٰمٌ فِیۡ یَوۡمٍ ذِیۡ مَسۡغَبَۃٍ ﴿ۙ۱۵﴾
verses.en: Or feeding in a day of hunger
An orphan near of kin,
Or a poor man lying in the dust.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ کَانَ مِنَ الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡمَرۡحَمَۃِ ﴿ؕ۱۸﴾
verses.en: Again, he should have been of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to mercy.
These are the people of the right hand.

verses.ar: وَالَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا بِاٰیٰتِنَا ہُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَشۡـَٔمَۃِ ﴿ؕ۲۰﴾
verses.en: But those who disbelieve Our Signs, they are the people of the left hand.
[✲]Around them will be a fire closed over.
